name: First Light
note: Tapped this afternoon. Mango, white peach, and a soft oat body that drinks like juice with manners.

name: Mill Whistle
note: Snappy noble hops over a cracker-dry lager base. The regulars' default first pour.

name: Static Bloom
note: Citra and Nelson stacked on a soft pale frame. This keg has never lasted two weekends.

name: Velvet Antler
note: Toasted hazelnut, caramel, and brown bread. Quietly the best beer in the building.

name: Third Shift
note: Espresso, cocoa nib, and an oat-slick body. Built for the patio fire barrel.

name: Gravel Road
note: Lemon peel, white pepper, bone dry. When this one blows it is gone until spring.

name: Paper Lantern
note: Blood orange squeezed into a bright, clean tart base. A handful of pours left at best.

name: Smokestack
note: Blew at 9:40 last night — campfire, dark chocolate, and a standing ovation. Back on next month.
